description: frame = "RPD1" | version 0x01 | reserved 0x00 | inner_len u16 BE | inner | 0x00 padding; the frame length is the smallest bucket of 512, 4096, 16384, 65519 that holds 8 + inner_len (RAVEN_LINK_PADDING_V1 §2). The inner frame is 65511 bytes, byte i = i mod 251; its frame is 65519 bytes (the largest bucket, MAX_TRANSPORT_PLAINTEXT) with no padding, given by its first bytes and its SHA-256. edges: the frame length of inner frames at each bucket's edges; refused: inner lengths a sender cannot pad (0, and 65512 or more)
name: PAD1 frame of the longest inner frame (bucket 65519) and the bucket edges
